layers.authority: Parks Australia, with Bininj/Mungguy Traditional Owners (joint management)
layers.process: A park pass is needed. 7-day pass A$40 adult, A$20 child, A$100 family, reduced to A$25, A$12.50 and A$65 for visits from 1 July to 31 October 2026. Separate from the Uluṟu-Kata Tjuṯa pass.

sources.title: Reduced park pass pricing announced for visitors to Kakadu

zone-requirements.note: Filming, photography for sale and research need separate permits from Parks Australia.
